artworks.title: Woman from the Villa Medici
artworks.medium: brown ink with gray wash over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length depiction of a person standing. The figure is positioned with their weight balanced on one leg, body slightly turned to the side. The person holds one hand raised with fingers curved, and the other arm extended downward with fingers open. The facial features are classical, with a well-defined profile, straight nose, and closed lips. The figure has curly hair falling around the shoulders and is wearing a long, flowing draped garment. The background is blank, and the illustration style is reminiscent of classical sculpture.

artworks.title: Woman from the Villa Albani
artworks.medium: black ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a person standing upright. The person is positioned with their weight slightly shifted to one side, with the right arm bent, holding a thin, elongated object. The left hand is clenched in a fist at chest level. The facial features are classicized, with a calm expression, and the head has wavy hair styled back. The figure is wearing draped clothing, reminiscent of classical attire, and circular earrings. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Orante from the Villa Medici
artworks.medium: brown ink with gray wash over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure standing upright. The person is holding a scroll in each hand and is facing slightly to the left. The facial features are classical, with a serene expression. The person has long, wavy hair partially covered by draped fabric. The clothing is flowing and layered, resembling classical Greco-Roman attire. No visible jewelry is present. The background is plain and unadorned, with subtle shading.

artworks.title: Woman with a Raised Hand, from the Villa Medici
artworks.medium: brown ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright. She has one arm raised and the other resting by her side. The woman's facial features are illustrated with an oval face, straight nose, and softly arched eyebrows. Her hair is styled in long, flowing curls. She wears a classical garment resembling a toga, with intricate draping that emphasizes the folds and curves of the fabric. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain with slight shading towards the edges of the image.

artworks.title: Woman with a Lyre
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body sketch of a person seated in a profile position facing slightly upward. The person is sitting with their feet resting on an invisible surface, leaning slightly forward as they play a lyre with their left hand. Their facial features are delicately defined, featuring a straight nose and closed lips, with an expression that conveys focus on the instrument. The individual's hair is styled in soft waves, pulled back, and appears to be tied at the back of the head. They are dressed in a flowing garment with loose sleeves and a layered skirt, which drapes naturally over their seated form. The sketch includes the person holding a large lyre, with strings and a frame visible. The background is sparse, consisting of a few light lines.

artworks.title: Faustine
artworks.medium: red chalk and gray wash with touches of black chalk over faint traces of graphite on beige laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure from head to toe in a side profile. The person is on a chair, with their left hand on their thigh and their right hand at their neck. The face has detailed features, including distinct cheekbones. The hair is styled in wavy, tied-back fashion. The attire resembles ancient Roman or Greek garments, with draped fabric creating folds and textures. The figure is barefoot, with toes visible. The background is plain, emphasizing the figure's pose.

artworks.title: Abundance and the Face of a Lion, from the Villa Pamphili
artworks.medium: black chalk and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated figure on a throne. The figure is draped in flowing robes and is seated on a chair or throne with an ornate design visible on its sides. Adjacent to the right arm of the figure is an accessory that resembles a vase or urn with smoke or a small flame emerging from it. Above the figure's head, there is a rough sketch of a profile of a face. The lines are primarily executed in a monochromatic scheme, with soft gray shading to indicate depth and volume.

artworks.title: Kneeling Woman Instructing a Child
artworks.medium: black chalk and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures kneeling on the ground facing towards the right side. One figure is an adult pointing upwards with their left hand and the other figure is a smaller child. The adult's facial features are in profile with short, wavy hair, looking towards the direction they are pointing. The child faces right with hands raised towards their face, less detailed in features and partially turned away. Both figures wear long robes or garments depicted in a monochrome style with shading indicating folds. The background is plain with no distinct details, emphasizing the two figures. No jewelry or objects are visible in the image.

artworks.title: Niobe and Her Daughter
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and gray wash over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This image shows an illustration of a woman standing upright. She is wearing flowing garments that suggest movement, with one knee bent as if in motion. Her hair is styled in tight curls and appears to be pulled back. The woman's facial expression is focused as she gazes upward or forward. She seems to be holding something in her right hand, while her left arm is hidden. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Leucothea, Front View
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a full-body pencil sketch of two figures. The main figure, an adult, is seated with a child on their lap, facing each other. The adult has a detailed face with distinct facial features and long, flowing hair that is styled in waves. Their expression is serene and attentive as they look directly at the child. The child is turned towards the adult, nestled against them with their head turned slightly away from the viewer, revealing only the back of their short, curly hair. Both figures are depicted with minimal clothing, resembling the drapes and folds often seen in classical attire, with the adult figure wrapped in a long garment that flows to the ground. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Leucothea, Side View
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed pencil sketch showing a woman holding a child on her lap. The woman is turned slightly to the side, looking at the child. Her facial features are delicately drawn with a soft expression, and her hair is styled in an updo. She is draped in cloth from the waist down, with her upper body bare. The child is facing her, with short hair and a tender expression, holding onto her arm. The background is minimalistic, suggesting a seat or ledge. No objects or jewelry are shown.

artworks.title: Hera and Ceres, from the Vatican
artworks.medium: black ink and gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features two full-body drawings of figures in classical attire. The figure on the left stands upright, holding a staff in their left hand and a portion of their garment in their right hand. They wear a draped robe that covers their body, leaving their feet exposed. The figure on the right stands with a scroll in their left hand, with similar attire and hairstyle. Both figures are set against a lightly textured background.

artworks.title: Two Female Figures from the Villa Medici
artworks.medium: brown ink and gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays two sculptures of classical figures draped in flowing garments. One sculpture, on the left, portrays a woman in a detailed gown on a pedestal. The other sculpture, on the right, depicts a figure, potentially male, in draped attire, holding an object in the left hand and extending the right arm slightly outwards. Both sculptures are monochrome and mounted on round pedestals, set in a classical environment. The sculptures showcase intricate details like fabric folds and facial features.

artworks.title: Two of the Three Graces, from San Giovanni Laterano
artworks.medium: black ink and gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body illustration of two figures standing side by side. Both figures are depicted in an upright position with their arms slightly extended; the left figure holds part of her attire, while the right figure’s arms rest by her sides. The facial features of both figures are sculpted and classical in style, with serene expressions, and their hair is styled in classical waves or curls that frame their heads. They are dressed in flowing garments, resembling robes or tunics, that drape elegantly to the floor, covering their bodies completely and creating folds and layers in the fabric. No jewelry or additional objects are visible on them. The background is plain and unadorned, drawing attention to the figures themselves. Shadows suggest a light source, adding depth to the monochromatic sketch.

artworks.title: Three Draped Women from the Boboli Gardens and the Uffizi
artworks.medium: gray wash over faint traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of three figures standing upright in different postures. Each figure is clothed in a long draping garment that covers their body completely. Their facial features are subtly defined, and their heads are covered by the garment. The figures have no visible accessories and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Figures from the Sarcophagus of the Muses
artworks.medium: gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of three figures. Two figures are fully visible from head to toe, while the third is only partially shown from the waist up. The figures are standing with varying postures and gestures. The facial features are not detailed, but the hair is styled in a classical manner. They are dressed in draped clothing resembling classical garments or robes. One figure seems to be interacting with an architectural element, possibly an altar or plinth. The background is simple, emphasizing the figures and their attire.

artworks.title: A Muse and Two Female Figures
artworks.medium: black chalk and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of three full-length figures standing upright and draped in flowing, classical-style garments. The first figure on the left has a slightly tilted head and holds an object in one hand, while the other hand rests near the chest. The second figure in the middle holds an indistinct object and has their head turned to the right. The third figure on the right is also looking to the right and rests one hand on a column or ledge. All three figures have classical-inspired hairstyles and subtle facial features. The background is blank, emphasizing the detailed shading and drapery of the garments. The paper shows signs of aging with small stains.

artworks.title: The Pantheon
artworks.medium: black ink and gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a monochromatic drawing of an urban scene with a classical structure on the left, featuring tall columns supporting a roof. Figures are seated at a table in the foreground, with a view of a city square beyond. The drawing includes buildings, rooftops, and a tower or obelisk in the distance. A horse-drawn cart is passing through the square, suggesting movement. The buildings are detailed with windows and doors, and the shading creates depth and shadow. The fine brushstrokes use shades of gray to depict a late afternoon or early evening setting, giving a classic and timeless atmosphere to the scene.

artworks.title: The Pantheon Seen from the Piazza
artworks.medium: black ink and gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street view with a large classical building on the right side, featuring a dome and columns. An obelisk stands near the building, and there are residential-like structures on the left side. Some smaller, more rustic buildings are in the foreground, and there are small figures present. The artwork is detailed, with linear brushstrokes and varying shades of grey and black.

artworks.title: The Piazza del Popolo
artworks.medium: brown ink and gray wash over faint traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This image features a city view captured from a slightly elevated perspective. A tall obelisk is at the center of the image, surrounded by small pillars. On the left is an archway with a structured facade. The horizon is visible, divided by architectural elements like buildings and cupolas. The illustration has precise brushstrokes outlining architectural features with a color palette of gray, beige, and sepia. Two human figures are in motion in the foreground, and in the distance, there are additional spires and rooftops under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Monte Cavallo, with the Horse Tamers
artworks.medium: brown ink and gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a classical architectural scene with statues, a building, and a cloudy sky. A statue of a man with two rearing horses on a pedestal is in the foreground, to the left. Two figures are walking towards a stately building on the right side. The building has detailed columns and a prominent entrance. The cloudy sky fills the top of the image with soft brushstrokes. The color scheme is muted, with shades of gray and black.

artworks.title: The Canonica of Sant'Ambrogio, Milan
artworks.medium: black chalk and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil and ink sketch of a building complex from a slightly elevated perspective. The drawing shows a rectangular, tiered building with a centralized structure. In the foreground, there are arched entrances and a few trees. The sketch uses fine, precise brushstrokes for a linear aesthetic with minimal shading. The color palette is monochrome, consisting of grays and blacks.

artworks.title: A Piazza with an Obelisk
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a pencil sketch of an architectural scene from a slightly elevated perspective. The composition features a tall obelisk on the right side, with classical-style buildings in the distance. Fine lines and delicate strokes are used to render details, creating an ethereal quality. The monochrome palette plays with light and shade, emphasizing architectural forms. The largest building is on the right, while the left side opens into a wider space, potentially a plaza.

artworks.title: The Capitoline Hill
artworks.medium: black chalk
artworks.description: This is a rooftop view of an urban landscape depicted in a detailed pencil sketch. The perspective shows rooftops and buildings densely packed together, with trees and a statue in the background. The sketch uses fine lines and shading to create texture and depth, capturing architectural details. The color palette is monochromatic, utilizing shades of gray for contrast and dimension. The pencil strokes effectively define forms and shadows, portraying an urban scene with elegance.
